Plants of the World Online account: Convallaria pseudomajalis W.Bartram.

The native range of this species is E. Central U.S.A. (Alleghey Mountains, Cherokis Mountains). It is a perennial or rhizomatous geophyte and grows primarily in the temperate biome.
